title: TarkeebAI Bubble Diagram Schema
description: The conditioning input for the HouseDiffusion plan generator (Phase 2). A bubble diagram is a graph: rooms are NODES, and an 'adjacency' is an EDGE meaning the two rooms share a wall / are connected by a door. HouseDiffusion does NOT read natural language or images — the orchestrating LLM translates the user's brief into this graph, then HouseDiffusion turns the graph into room polygons. This is the contract between Layer 2 (orchestrator) and the HouseDiffusion engine.

plot.description: Plot size in meters. The model generates a normalized unit layout; the bridge scales it to fit this plot. Defaults to 10x20 (classic Iraqi plot) if omitted.

id.description: Unique room id used to reference this room in 'adjacencies', e.g. 'r1'

type.description: TarkeebAI room type (same vocabulary as plan_schema.json). It is mapped to the nearest RPLAN class the model was trained on.

corners.description: How many corners the room polygon should have. 4 = rectangle (default). Use 6 for an L-shaped room. The model generates the coordinates; this only fixes the corner count.

adjacencies.description: Undirected edges. Each edge [a, b] means rooms a and b are adjacent / connected by a door. Rooms not listed in any edge are auto-connected to the main living room by the bridge (HouseDiffusion's own fallback).
